message: the configured cooldown value cannot be interpreted; treat as unprotected
dependency lifecycle scripts run unrestricted — add ignore-scripts=true to .npmrc so no dependency executes code at install time
git dependencies present in the lockfile: git-dep — they bypass registry protections (cooldown, provenance, immutability)
package-lock.json is listed in .gitignore — remove that entry and commit the lockfile
CI installs without honoring the lockfile: `npm install` (line 9) — use npm ci / pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
1 package(s) resolve over insecure http from registry.evil.example (evil-pkg)
strict-ssl=false in .npmrc disables TLS verification for registry traffic
script-shell is overridden in .npmrc (/bin/bash) — lifecycle scripts run under a non-default interpreter
registry override in .npmrc: registry=http://registry.evil.example/ — installs are redirected away from the default registry
plaintext credential in .npmrc (key: //registry.evil.example/:_authToken) — revoke it and reference an environment variable like ${NPM_TOKEN} instead
